action_summary: Three defects in one seam, all in how a compound sentence's later clause is completed. (1) _compile_compound_goal started context_paths=[] and only ever appended its own artifacts, so a clause that names no path had no world to inherit and fell through to world_binding_v1, which scans the tool's cwd. (2) _context_path_for_key could only answer file-shaped keys, so a scope slot (source_root) never inherited anything at all. (3) world binding filled a *_paths slot with a single path, so the adapter iterated a string and died FILE_INVALID. Measured values on e9861f4 for "The tests in <b>/tests are failing. Fix the code so they pass.": test_paths = canonical/astra_runtime/state/env_toolchain/pytest_run.py, source_root = "." and "canonical/tests". Fixed where they live: the request's own named paths seed the context every clause inherits; a scope slot takes the directory the request named; a list slot never holds a scalar; a referent may not leave the request's world (inside a named path, or exactly one step outside it); and a clause that demands a CHANGE is refused when the selected capability's own `provides` tokens name no change, or when the request left the tree byte-identical. That last law removes a false success this change would otherwise have created: with the bindings repaired, the plan executed, changed nothing, left the suite red, and reported PASS. Census and tiers are unchanged at 2/28 and 2/10 -- the machine now refuses honestly where it used to lie.
